title: AtlasTable
description: Normalized sprite-sheet frame tables translated from the original Cocos2d .plist files. No plist/XML is ever committed or read at runtime; this is the project-native replacement.

additionalProperties.description: One atlas, keyed by its PNG image path (relative to assets/).

image.description: Atlas PNG path relative to assets/.

rotated.description: If true, packed at 90deg; draw swaps w/h and rotates.

offsetX.description: Trim offset; Cocos2d subpixel data can be fractional (e.g. 1.5).

offsetY.description: Trim offset; Cocos2d subpixel data can be fractional (e.g. 1.5).
